In terms of the Pauli matrices $\sigma_x$ and $\sigma_z$, the qubit Hamiltonian is
$H = \Delta\sigma_x + \epsilon\sigma_z$, and the evolution operator over a time $t$ factorizes as
\begin{equation}
e^{-i(\Delta\sigma_x + \epsilon\sigma_z)t} = e^{-i\Delta\sigma_x t}\,e^{-i\epsilon\sigma_z t} .
\label{eq:fact}
\end{equation}
